note: Copied byte-for-byte from the read-only backend clone; the backend was not modified. Operations already include the API prefix, so clients use a validated deployment origin. The generator filter selects implemented operations and their generated dependencies. The mechanical build projection selects documented JSON request media or an optional no-body request where malformed content declares no media type, and opens every string enum reachable from a selected operation's response (PRD §7: an unknown enum value must decode; the app maps values in hand-written wrappers). Paths, DTO fields and response shapes are preserved.
